ArtifactStage.description: Where an artifact sits in a run's raw -> intermediate -> final pipeline.
ArtifactStage.title: ArtifactStage

description: Points at one stored artifact and how it fits into a run's lineage.

artifact_id.description: Unique ID for this artifact reference.
artifact_id.title: Artifact Id

content_hash.description: Lowercase 64-character hex SHA-256 digest of the artifact's content.
content_hash.title: Content Hash

creator_capability.description: Capability path that produced this artifact.
creator_capability.title: Creator Capability

creator_capability_version.description: Version of that capability at the time it produced this artifact.
creator_capability_version.title: Creator Capability Version

derived_from.description: artifact_id of each artifact this one was derived from. Empty for a raw artifact with no upstream input captured by this store.
derived_from.title: Derived From

schema_version.description: Schema MAJOR.MINOR this record was written against.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

stage.description: raw (untransformed input), intermediate (a transformation step's output), or final (a run's end result).

trace_id.description: trace_id of the ExecutionContext that produced this artifact.
trace_id.title: Trace Id

title: ArtifactRef
